blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models suffer significant accuracy drops under common corruptions. While test-time adaptation (TTA) successfully mitigates these shifts in CLIP-like contrastive models, its application to generative multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains underexplored and uniquely challenging due to their sequential token generation. In this work, we demonstrate that representation-based TTA fails to recover performance in MLLMs. Our experiments reveal that even when violating standard TTA assumptions by leveraging target data offline, sample-blind feature alignment recovers only marginal accuracy. We attribute this failure to the nature of corruption shifts: unlike CLIP-like architectures, which benefit from a shared domain-shift direction within a single pooled classification embedding, MLLM visual token sequence shifts are nearly orthogonal and span the full embedding space.These findings bound what any sample-blind, position-shared correction at a single encoder site can achieve, establishing that representation-space interventions alone might be insufficient to ensure corruption robustness in MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 在常见的腐败下,愿景语言模型的准确度大幅下降。 虽然测试时间适应(TTA)在类似CLIP的对比模型中成功地缓解了这些转变,但是它对于基因多式大语言模型(MLLMs)的应用由于它们相继生成符号,仍然没有得到充分利用和独特的挑战. 在这项工作中,我们表明,基于代表性的TTA未能在MLLM中恢复性能. 我们的实验显示,即使通过利用离线目标数据来违反标准的TTA假设,样本盲特性对齐也只能恢复边际精度. 我们将此失败归因于腐败转变的性质:与类似CLIP的架构不同,这种架构受益于单一集合分类嵌入内的一个共享域-转移方向,MLLM视觉符号序列转移几乎是正向的,跨越了完整的嵌入空间. 这些结论将单一编码器站点的任何抽样盲点、位置共享校正所能达到的目标联系在一起,确定仅仅代表-空间干预可能不足以确保MLLMs的腐败力度。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Matching corrupted activations to clean statistics repairs a linear probe, but not the MLLM’s answers. For the probe, the statistics are matched on one pooled vector per image. For the MLLM, they are matched on individual visual tokens.
blocks.zh: 图1:匹配被腐蚀的活化器以清理统计修复线性探测器,但MLLM的答案并非如此. 就探测器而言,每个图像都有一个集合矢量的数据相匹配。 对于MLLM来说,它们被匹配在单个视觉符号上.

blocks.en:
Vision-language models (VLMs) excel on a broad range of visual tasks, yet they inherit the brittleness of their visual encoders.
Common corruptions such as sensor noise, defocus, and brightness shifts can substantially degrade accuracy even when the scene remains clearly recognizable.
Since this degradation arises at deployment, where only unlabeled, already-corrupted inputs are available, test-time adaptation (TTA) fits precisely this setting, adapting a pretrained model to the incoming test stream without labels.
blocks.zh:
视觉语言模型(VLMs)在广泛的视觉任务上表现优异,然而它们却继承了视觉编码器的脆性.
常见的腐败,如感官噪声,分焦,亮度变化等,即使场景仍然清晰地被辨认出来,也能使精度大幅降低.
由于这种退化是在部署时发生的,那里只有未加标签的、已经腐蚀的输入,因此试验时间适应(TTA)正好适合这种设置,将预先训练过的模型适应到没有标签的来袭试验流。

blocks.en:
VLMs, however, span substantially different architectures.
Contrastive models such as CLIP [ 26 ] and SigLIP [ 46 ] align images and text through a single pooled embedding per modality, whereas multimodal large language models (MLLMs) pass a sequence of visual tokens through a connector into an autoregressive language model that generates the response.
Existing TTA work for VLMs targets almost exclusively the former: the recent TTA-VLM benchmark evaluates fifteen methods across fifteen datasets, finds gains over the earliest baseline to be marginal even there, and leaves evaluation beyond CLIP-like models and beyond classification as open problems [ 35 ] .
To our knowledge, adapting MLLMs to common corruptions at test time has not been studied, leaving practitioners who deploy them in noisy real-world environments with little evidence about whether their degraded visual performance can be recovered at all.
blocks.zh:
然而,虚拟内容跨度大相径庭。
CLIP [26]和SigLIP [46]等相矛盾的模型通过每个模式的单一集合嵌入来将图像和文本对齐,而多式大语言模型(MLLMs)则通过连接器将一系列可视符号传递到生成响应的自旋语言模型中.
现有技术评估针对VLM的工作几乎完全针对前者:最近的TTA-VLM基准在15个数据集中评价了15个方法,发现对最早基线的增益即使在那里也微乎其微,而评价超出了类似CLIP的模型,超出了分类范围,成为尚未解决的问题[35]。
据我们所知,在测试时将MLLMs与常见腐败相适应还没有被研究过,使得部署在吵闹现实环境中的从业者对于其退化的视觉性能能否完全恢复几乎没有证据.

blocks.en:
A natural starting point for recovering it is representation-based TTA, which corrects internal activations at inference time without updating any weights.
If a corruption induces a consistent shift in representation space, a single sample-blind correction, estimated from activation statistics and applied to every input, should in principle undo it.
Such methods need no gradients or labels and assume no fixed output space, making them among the few TTA approaches that remain practical at MLLM scale ( Section 2 ).
They have been validated, however, mainly on classification, where a prediction follows from one pooled representation per image.
The token-sequence setting is substantially more demanding: a successful correction must restore the structure of the entire sequence rather than a single image-level vector.
blocks.zh:
复原的一个自然起点是基于表示的TTA,它并不更新任何权重,而是在推断时纠正内部活化.
如果腐败导致代表空间的一贯变化,那么从激活统计中估计并应用于每一项投入的单一样本盲修正原则上应当予以撤销。
这类方法不需要梯度或标签,也不假定固定输出空间,使其成为少数在MLLM规模上仍然实用的TTA方法(第2节)。
然而,它们主要通过分类得到验证,根据每个图像一个集合代表的预测。
符号序列设置要求要高得多:成功的校正必须恢复整个序列的结构,而不是一个单一的图像级向量.

blocks.en:
We therefore ask whether sample-blind representation corrections can recover the performance MLLMs lose to common corruptions.
We apply feature alignment, matching the per-dimension mean and variance of visual-token activations to their clean values, at layers spanning the vision encoders of three modern MLLMs on RealWorldQA under 15 common corruptions.
Accuracy stays close to the no-TTA baseline throughout: no layer, model, or corruption closes a meaningful fraction of the corruption gap, even when the alignment maps are fitted offline from paired clean–corrupted activations ( Figure 2 ).
The contrast in Figure 1 is the central one: aligning corrupted projector activations with the clean distribution recovers most of the gap for a linear probe on a pooled representation, but none of it for the MLLM’s own answers.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们问,对抽样-盲表示的纠正能否使 MLLMs 失去的性能恢复到常见的腐败。
我们应用特性对齐,在15个常见的腐败下,在跨越RealWorldQA上的3个现代MLLMs的视觉编码器的层次上,将可视化活化的每分量平均值和差异与他们的清洁值相匹配。
准确性始终接近无TTA基线:没有层、模型或腐败可以弥补腐败差距中有意义的一分点,即使对接地图是从对接的清洁-腐败激活下接而来(图2)。
图1的对比点是中心点:将腐败的投影器活化与干净的分布相配合,为集合代表物上的线性探测器回收了大部分缺口,但对于MLLM本身的答案却没有任何漏洞.

blocks.en:
Why these corrections fail is a property of the shifts themselves.
They are nearly orthogonal across images and collectively span almost the full embedding space ( Figure 4 ), so the component a sample-blind correction can remove accounts for only a small fraction of the total ( Figure 3 ).
Nor does any small subset of patches or feature dimensions carry a disproportionate share of the effect ( Figure 5 ).
There is no shared direction to remove: effective restoration would have to be specific not only to each sample but to each token within it ( Section 4 ).
blocks.zh:
为何这些改正失败是轮班本身的财产。
它们几乎横跨了图像,并共同覆盖了几乎完整的嵌入空间(图4),因此一个样本-盲校正的组件只能去除占总数的一小部分(图3).
任何小分集的补丁或地物维度也没有带来不成比例的效应份额(图5 )。
没有任何共同的方向可以去除:有效的恢复不仅必须针对每个样本,而且还必须针对其中的每个标志物(第4节)。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We provide, to our knowledge, the first evaluation of test-time adaptation for MLLMs, studying representation-based corrections across three models and 15 corruptions. We find no practically significant gains. • We characterize the corruption-induced shifts and explain why sample-blind corrections fail, including a quantitative bound on the fraction of the shift that such corrections can remove.
blocks.zh: - 我们的捐助如下: 据我们所知,我们提供了对MLLMs测试时间适应的第一次评估,研究了三个模式和15个腐败中基于代表性的纠正。 • 我们没有看到任何实际重大的成果。 我们描述腐败引起的转变,并解释为什么盲从纠正失败,包括这种纠正能够消除的转移的一小部分。

blocks.en: We provide, to our knowledge, the first evaluation of test-time adaptation for MLLMs, studying representation-based corrections across three models and 15 corruptions. We find no practically significant gains.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Despite their impressive capabilities, VLMs exhibit well-documented shortcomings: they hallucinate content not grounded in the visual input [ 16 ] , overlook information present in their own visual representations in favor of language priors [ 37 , 7 , 38 ] , fail to express reduced confidence on ambiguous inputs [ 40 ] , and flip answers under minor input perturbations [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 尽管具有令人印象深刻的能力,但VLM表现出了详细记载的缺点:它们幻觉了并非基于视觉输入的内容[16],忽略了自己视觉表现中的信息,偏向于语言前传[37,7,38],未能表达对模糊输入的信心下降[40],在小输入扰动下翻转答案[30].

blocks.en:
A complementary line of work probes this fragility with common image corruptions, popularized by ImageNet-C [ 9 ] as a controlled and reproducible testbed for the degradations encountered in real-world deployment; a growing body of benchmarks extends this paradigm to MLLMs [ 5 , 12 , 25 , 32 ] .
Notably, despite internet-scale pretraining, MLLMs still degrade substantially under such corruptions regardless of model scale, yet these benchmarks diagnose the problem without proposing remedies.
blocks.zh:
互为补充的工作线通过常见的图像腐败来探寻这种脆弱性,这种腐败被ImageNet-C[9]所普及,作为现实世界部署中遇到的退化的一种可控制和可复制的测试;越来越多的基准将这一范式扩展到了MLLM[5、12、25、32]。
值得注意的是,尽管有互联网规模的预先培训,在这种腐败下,不论规模大小,MLLMs仍然大幅下降,但这些基准却在不提出补救办法的情况下判断出问题。

blocks.en: Among the few mitigation approaches, Liu et al. [16] steer latent representations at inference time to reduce hallucinations, while Manifold-Adversarial Adapters (MAA) [ 13 ] improve corruption robustness by aligning features of corrupted images with their clean counterparts. MAA, however, requires a large training set of paired clean–corrupted images and multiple epochs of adapter training–assumptions violated in deployment, where only unlabeled, already-corrupted test samples are available.
blocks.zh: 在为数不多的缓解方针中,刘等. [16] 在推论时引导潜在表达来减少幻觉,而Manifold-Adversarial适配器[13]则通过将被腐蚀图像的特征与干净的相配来提高腐败的强度。 但是,MAA需要一套大型的训练,配对的清洁-损坏图像和多个适配器训练时代的假设在部署中被违反,那里只有未经标记的已经损坏的试验样品。

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, no prior work adapts general-purpose MLLMs to corrupted images directly at test time, using only unlabeled test samples–the gap this work addresses.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,没有一项前期工作在测试时直接将通用的 MLLMs 适应被损坏的图像,只使用无标签的测试样本 — — 这个工作地址的空白。

blocks.en:
Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) addresses distribution shift at deployment by adapting a pretrained model to an unlabeled test stream [ 44 , 14 ] .
Classic approaches utilize backpropagation-based weight updates with self-supervised objectives that fall into three families: entropy minimization, as in TENT [ 39 ] and SAR [ 20 ] ; pseudo-labeling, in which the model’s confident predictions serve as surrogate labels [ 3 ] ; and feature alignment, which matches test-time activation statistics to those of the source domain, as in ActMAD [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh:
测试-时间适应(TTA)在部署时通过将预先训练的模型与无标签的测试流相适应来解决分布转移[44,14].
经典方法利用基于反扩散的权重更新,其自我监督的目标属于三个家族:最小化,如TENT[39]和SAR[20];假标签,其中模型的自信预测作为替代标签[3];以及特征相匹配,如ActMAD[18],将试验时间激活统计与源域的统计相匹配。

blocks.en:
These recipes transfer poorly to MLLMs.
Backpropagation-based updates are computationally prohibitive at the scale of modern VLMs. Entropy- and pseudo-label-based objectives presuppose a fixed label space and calibrated uncertainty, whereas MLLMs generate open-ended text and remain confident when wrong [ 40 ] . Online self-supervised updates carry a well-documented risk of model collapse and catastrophic forgetting [ 24 , 33 ] .
blocks.zh:
这些食谱向MLLMs的转移很差.
基于反扩散的更新在计算上与现代VLM的规模相比是令人无法接受的. 基于Entropy和假标签的目标以固定的标签空间和校准的不确定性为前提,而MLLMs则产生可扩展的文本,并在错误时保持信心 [40]. 在线自导自演的更新,有详细记载的模型倒塌和灾难性遗忘的风险[24,33].

blocks.en: Recent efforts extend TTA beyond classification to dense prediction and regression [ 1 , 22 ] . MLLMs, however, remain largely unaddressed. A large body of work exists for CLIP-like architectures [ 35 ] , such as test-time prompt tuning [ 36 ] . These methods treat CLIP strictly as a zero-shot classifier, inheriting standard classification assumptions.
blocks.zh: 最近的努力将TTA扩展到了分类以外的密集预测和回归[1,22]. 然而,MLLMs基本上仍未得到解决。 对CLIP类建筑存在一大批作品[35],如试时快调[36]. 这些方法将CLIP严格视为零发分级器,继承了标准分级假设.

blocks.en:
To the best of our knowledge, Kaya et al. [10] is the only existing work on TTA for MLLMs.
Their method aggregates predictions from augmented inputs at the token level and optionally updates parameters from the resulting pseudo-labels. However, it targets general test-time scaling for small MLLMs rather than robustness to input corruptions, and lacks evaluation under common corruptions.
To address these gaps, we test whether activation engineering can provide a practical way to adapt MLLMs to corrupted images directly at test time.
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,Kaya等人 [10]是目前唯一一部针对MLLMs的TTA作品.
他们的方法汇总了从符号级上增加输入的预测,并可选地从产生的伪标签上更新参数. 然而,它针对的是小型微额供资和微型企业,而不是投入腐败的稳健性,并且缺乏在常见腐败下的评价。
为了弥补这些差距,我们测试激活工程是否能够提供一种实用的方法来使MLLMs在测试时直接被腐蚀的图像被改造.

blocks.en:
Two largely independent lines of work modify a model’s behavior at inference time by acting on its activations rather than its weights.
In the LLM community this is known as activation engineering or steering [ 49 ] .
The most notable Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) [ 27 ] computes a difference-of-means vector from contrastive prompt pairs and adds it to the residual stream.
In MLLMs, such interventions have so far been used to control high-level semantic behavior, e.g., to improve visual grounding or reduce hallucinations [ 16 , 11 , 23 ] .
Recently Activation Transport (AcT) [ 28 , 29 ] reframes steering as optimal transport between source and target activation distributions.
blocks.zh:
两条基本上独立的线条工作通过在模型的激活而不是其分量上采取行动来修改模型在推断时间的行为.
在LLM社区,这被称为活化工程或引导 [49].
最出名的对比活性增量(CAA)[27]计算出从对比的活性对上得到的异能矢量,并添加到残流中.
在MLLMs中,这种干预措施迄今为止被用于控制高层次的语义行为,例如改善视觉地基或减少幻觉[16,11,23].
近期活化运输(AcT)[28,29]将活化引导作为源活化分布与目标活化分布之间的最优化运输.

blocks.en:
In the TTA literature, the analogous operation—matching test-time features to those of the source domain—is called feature alignment [ 34 ] , and it underlies a recent wave of backpropagation-free methods that avoid the instabilities of gradient-based adaptation: FOA [ 21 ] shifts the last-layer CLS token back toward source activations, NEO [ 19 ] re-centers test embeddings by a single vector, TCA [ 45 ] aligns correlations of cached representations, and PEA [ 43 ] realigns intermediate features via a layer-wise whitening–coloring transform (WCT).
Despite being lightweight and architecture-agnostic, all of these are developed and evaluated exclusively on image classifiers.
blocks.zh:
在TTA文献中,类似操作——匹配源域的测试时间特征——称为特征对接[34],它支撑了最近避免梯度调整不稳定的无反扩散方法浪潮:FOA[21]将最后一层CLS符号向源活化的后移,近地天体[19]由单一载体再中心测试嵌入,TCA[45]对缓存表示的关联性进行比对,PEA[43]通过分层白-彩色变换来调整中间特征。
尽管这些是轻而易举的建筑-不可知论的,但它们都是完全通过图像分类器来制定和评估的。

blocks.en:
In this work we consider the Gaussian case of AcT (Gaussian-AcT), requiring only source statistics rather than source samples. It recovers existing feature-alignment methods as special cases—the re-centering of NEO and FOA without the scaling term and the WCT of PEA with full covariance.
To our knowledge, we are the first to repurpose activation steering for the low-level representation shifts induced by visual corruptions in MLLMs.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们认为高斯人AcT(高斯人-AcT)案件,只要求来源统计数据,而不是来源样本. 它恢复了作为特殊情况的现有特征调整方法——在没有缩放条件的情况下重新聚集近地物体和FOA,以及完全一致地恢复PEA的WPT。
据我们所知,我们是第一个重新确定激活方向的人,以适应由MLLMs的视觉腐败所引发的低层代表变化。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct [ 2 ] , InternVL3-2B [ 48 ] , and Ovis2-4B [ 17 ] on RealWorldQA [ 42 ] , a vision-centric multiple-choice question answering (MCQ) benchmark of 765 questions on real-world scenes, under the 15 common corruptions [ 9 ] at severity 5, with images resized to 896 × 896 896\times 896 pixels.
We use VLMEvalKit [ 6 ] to keep the evaluation protocol standardized and reproducible across all models and methods.
All three models share the LLaVA architecture [ 15 ] : a vision encoder maps the image to patch embeddings, a projector maps each into the token-embedding space of a language model, and the language model processes the resulting visual tokens together with the text.
Unlike a classifier, the language model reads every visual token rather than a single pooled vector; every method we study edits these token activations at test time and leaves all parameters frozen.
We edit vision encoder activations, where the corruption-induced shift originates and is still purely visual, so one correction estimated from images alone serves every question about the image.
The edited blocks, which we call the intervention layers , and the remaining details are given in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
我们评价了Wen2.5-VL-3B-指示 [2], InternVL3-2B [48], 和Ovis2-4B [17] 在RealWorldQA [42]上, 一个以视觉为中心的多选择问题解答(MCQ)基准, 现实世界场景中的765个问题, 在15个常见腐败 [9] 在严重性5下, 图像被调整为896×896896\时896像素.
我们使用VLMEvalKit[6],使评价协议标准化,并可在所有模式和方法中复制。
所有三种模型都共享LLaVA架构[15]: 一个视觉编码器将图像映射到补丁嵌入,一个投影仪将每个图像映射到语言模型的符号-嵌入空间,语言模型将由此产生的视觉符号与文本一起处理.
与分类器不同的是,语言模型读取每个视觉符号,而不是单个集合向量;我们研究的每一种方法都会在测试时编辑这些符号活化并留下所有参数被冻结.
我们编辑视觉编码器的激活, 腐败引发的转变起源于那里, 并且仍然是纯粹的视觉的, 因此,一个从图像中估计的校正 服务于每一个关于图像的问题。

The moments are estimated either globally , one pair ( μ , σ ) (\mu,\sigma) per layer shared by all tokens, or per-token , one pair per token position across images.
Both variants are sample-blind : the same map is applied to every image and depends only on the token position, which is known at test time.

blocks.en:
Table 1: Online TTA with Gaussian-AcT barely moves accuracy on any of the three MLLMs. RealWorldQA accuracy (%) under the 15 common corruptions at severity 5. no-TTA is the accuracy without adaptation.
The Gaussian-AcT columns give the change Δ \Delta over it in pp when applied at all intervention layers, without and with dynamic weighting.
Cells with | Δ | ≥ 2 |\Delta|\geq 2 pp are shaded green for a gain and red for a loss.
The better of the two corrections per corruption is in bold .

In online adaptation, the target statistics of the Gaussian-AcT map are estimated from the test stream itself, given only the precomputed source statistics, so the correction should improve as more corrupted data arrives.
Each corruption forms a separate stream and the target statistics are reset between corruptions.
We report means over three stream orders with the between-order standard deviation.
We apply the map with per-token moments at every intervention layer, either unweighted or with dynamic weighting , adapted from PEA [ 43 ] , which scales the correction of each layer by how far its running target statistics have drifted from the source statistics (more details in Appendix B ).

Averaged over the 15 corruptions ( Table 1 ), the unweighted correction gains + 0.8 +0.8 and + 1.6 +1.6 pp on InternVL3-2B and Ovis2-4B but loses 1.7 1.7 pp on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, and individual corruptions swing by several points in either direction.
Dynamic weighting lifts Qwen2.5-VL-3B to + 1.1 +1.1 pp and leaves the other two models unchanged at + 1.0 +1.0 and + 1.6 +1.6 pp.
These gains recover 12 % 12\% , 9 % 9\% , and 15 % 15\% of the 8.1 8.1 , 12.3 12.3 , and 10.4 10.4 pp that corruption costs each model.
The weighting achieves this by switching the correction off rather than by improving it: the weight concentrates on the earliest layers, and accuracy improves only gradually as the stream progresses ( Figures 7 and 6 ).

The feature alignment that works for image classification does not carry over to MLLMs, even when they adapt to one corruption at a time.

Gaussian-AcT is deliberately simple: a diagonal affine map fitted to distribution statistics estimated online.
A null result could therefore be attributed to the estimator, to the expressivity of the map, to its supervision, or to the site of the intervention.
We rule out each in turn.

blocks.en:
At the single intervention block, per-token moments estimated online match the same map fitted offline on the full test set, with per-corruption gains correlated at r = 0.93 r=0.93 ( Figure 9 ), and pooling the moments over token positions lowers the gain on every model ( Figure 8 ).
Per-token moments are therefore preferable, yet they still recover only about one point.

因此,瞬间更可取,但它们仍然只恢复了约一分。

blocks.en:
We next drop the online constraint and fit maps offline, with clean and corrupted images available together, and vary expressivity (linear vs. nonlinear) and supervision (unpaired statistics vs. paired tokens, each corrupted token regressed onto its own clean counterpart).
Paired supervision is unavailable to any test-time method, so these results bound what such a method could achieve rather than propose one.
Every map is shared across token positions and takes only the token’s own activation as input.
Gaussian-AcT and its full-covariance counterpart WCT are fitted from distribution statistics, whereas a closed-form ridge regression and a two-layer MLP are fitted on paired tokens of 500 images.
All maps are evaluated on the remaining 265 held-out images.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 shows that neither factor changes the outcome.
The oracle MLP recovers at most a quarter of the held-out gap ( + 0.50 +0.50 , + 3.25 +3.25 , and + 2.54 +2.54 pp against gaps of 5.8 5.8 , 15.2 15.2 , and 10.7 10.7 pp), and only at a shallow layer.
WCT stays within one standard error of Gaussian-AcT despite fitting a full covariance, and the paired ridge map lowers accuracy at most layers despite its oracle supervision: least squares returns the conditional mean of the clean token given the corrupted one, so the detail it cannot predict is shrunk away.
What a single-layer, position-shared correction can recover is thus bounded regardless of estimator, expressivity, or supervision.
blocks.zh:

WPT尽管配上了完全的同位素,但仍停留在高斯-AcT的一个标准误差内,而配对的山脊图尽管它的甲骨文监督,却在大多数地层中降低了精度:最小的正方形返回了被腐蚀的"干净"的有条件的平均值,因此它无法预测的细节被收缩了.
单层、位置共享的校正能够恢复的是什么,因此,无论评价、表述或监督如何,都是有限度的。

blocks.en:
The MLP’s failure says more than this bound.
Its correction is a nonlinear function of the input token, but it uses neither the token’s position, which per-token moments already capture, nor information from the other tokens of the image.
The shift of a token is therefore not recoverable from that token alone. Undoing it requires the information from the rest of the image, which places the problem closer to restoration than to feature alignment.
blocks.zh:
MLP的失败不仅限于此。
它的校正是输入符的一种非线性函数,但它既不使用每秒已捕捉到的符号位置,也不使用从图像其他符号得到的信息.
因此,仅从该信使身上无法收回一个信使的转移。 解除它需要从图像的其余部分得到信息,这使得问题更接近恢复而不是特征对齐.

blocks.en:
At the intervention layers, interpolating each token’s activation from its corrupted toward its clean value recovers accuracy in proportion to the interpolation weight ( Appendix E ), so a perfect per-token correction at a single layer would close the gap.
Nor does the damage concentrate elsewhere in the encoder: activation patching, which overwrites the output of one encoder sub-module, the attention or MLP branch of a block, with its clean-image activation, upper-bounds what any adaptation applied there can achieve, and except for Ovis2’s projector-side MLP no single sub-module recovers more than about half of the gap, at a location that depends on the architecture ( Appendix D ).
What sample-blind adaptation lacks is therefore not a place to intervene but a correction specific to each token.
blocks.zh:
在干预层中,将每个信使的激活从被腐蚀到其清洁价值的插入恢复到与插入分量(附录E)成正比的准确性,因此,一个单层的完美逐个校正将缩小差距。
损坏也没有集中在编码器的其他地方:活化补丁,它覆盖了一个编码器子模块的输出,一个块的注意力或MLP分支,它的清洁成像活化,上面是任何在那里应用的适应能够实现的目标,除了Ovis2的投影-侧MLP之外,没有一个单个子模块在一个依赖于架构的位置恢复了约一半的缺口(附录D.
因此, " 盲 " 适应缺乏的不是进行干预的地方,而是每个标志特有的更正。

blocks.en:
Feature alignment succeeds in image classification, where the prediction is read from a single pooled representation per image, the CLS token or mean-pooled activations, whether the correction is applied to that vector alone [ 21 , 19 ] or to every token of the intermediate layers [ 43 ] .
Averaging the token-level shifts of each image reproduces this view: the position-specific and residual components average out, and Equation 1 reduces to ∑ i ∥ m i ∥ 2 2 = N ​ ∥ μ ∥ 2 2 + ∑ i ∥ m i − μ ∥ 2 2 \sum_{i}\lVert m_{i}\rVert_{2}^{2}=N\lVert\mu\rVert_{2}^{2}+\sum_{i}\lVert m_{i}-\mu\rVert_{2}^{2} .
In this pooled view the decomposition inverts (hatched bars in Figure 3 , dashed lines in Figure 4 ).
Pooled shifts of different images are strongly aligned and span few directions, and the global shift μ \mu accounts for the majority of the squared pooled shift at almost every intervention layer of all three models, so a single sample-blind shift captures most of what there is to correct.
The residual that dominates the token-level shift is thus not removed by pooling, only averaged out of the vector a classifier reads, while the language model reads the tokens themselves, residual included.

Prior work shows that the task-relevant visual signal in MLLMs is highly concentrated: most visual
tokens can be pruned with little accuracy loss [ 4 ] , and cropping to a single question-relevant region recovers much of the accuracy lost on fine-grained VQA [ 47 , 41 ] .
If the degradation caused by corruption were similarly concentrated, repairing a small subset of the representation would suffice, and correction would reduce to a selection problem.

We test this with an oracle intervention at the final encoder block of all three models, under Gaussian noise at severity 5.
We replace a random subset of the corrupted activation with the clean activation of the same image and sweep the size of the subset along two axes: whole token positions, and feature dimensions across all positions.

blocks.en:
Recovery requires restoring a large fraction of the representation on either axis ( Figure 5 ): half of the gap costs roughly a third of all patches or
60% of all feature dimensions.
For Qwen2.5-VL-3B, the two axes differ in shape, while for the remaining two models the curves nearly align ( Figures 14 and 15 ) having a steeper slope at lower fractions.
Patch recovery is concave and begins immediately, whereas dimension recovery is flat below about 20% of the dimensions and stays below the proportional rate throughout: corruption is spread across nearly all feature dimensions and somewhat unevenly across positions.
Choosing the subset by the magnitude or the variance of the clean activations instead of at random rescales these curves by at most a constant factor and leaves their shape unchanged ( Section H.1 ).
The concentration that token pruning and visual cropping exploit therefore does not extend to the degradation caused by corruption: no small region of the representation carries it, and no selection rule we tested finds one.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion, Limitations, and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论、限制和未来工作

blocks.en:
Across three MLLMs and 15 corruptions, representation-based TTA recovers about one percentage point of a drop an order of magnitude larger, and no variant of the method changes this: online or offline estimation, global or per-token moments, linear or nonlinear maps, and unpaired or paired supervision recover at most a few points ( Sections 3.1 and 3.2 ).
Prompting about the degradation does not help either, and the confidence signal on which entropy-based objectives rely barely predicts correctness ( Sections I.1 and I.2 ).
The reason is the structure of the shift, not the method: it is almost entirely token-specific ( Section 4.1 ), so a sample-blind correction has little to correct, whereas pooled per image, as a classifier reads it, the same shift is dominated by a shared direction, which is why feature alignment works for classification.
The correction that would work must be specific to each sample and token, and no small subset of tokens or dimensions carries it ( Section 4.2 ).
Adapting MLLMs to corruptions is therefore a per-token restoration problem rather than a feature-alignment problem, and sample-blind corrections should not be expected to repair corruption damage at deployment.
blocks.zh:
在3起MLLM和15起腐败中,基于代表性的TTA恢复了约一个百分点的下降幅度较大,方法的任何变体都无法改变这一点:在线或离线估计、全球或每起事件、线性或非线性地图,以及无担保或对等监管在多数几起事件上恢复(第3.1和3.2节)。
催促降解也无济于事,而以肽为基础的目标所依赖的信心信号几乎无法预测正确性(第一.1和一.2节)。
原因是移位的结构,而不是方法:它几乎完全是象征性的(第4.1节),所以一个样盲校正几乎没有什么可以纠正的,而每个图像的集合,如一个分类者所读,同一个移位被一个共同的方向所主导,这就是为什么特征校正为分类工作.
改正工作必须针对每个样本和标志,任何小的标志或维度都不得带有(第4.2节)。
因此,使MLLMs适应腐败是一个每起一次的修复问题,而不是一个特征调整问题,不应指望在部署时进行抽样盲修正来修复腐败损害。

blocks.en:
We test only sample-blind corrections: none is estimated from the image it corrects, and none draws on the rest of the image.
The study is preliminary in scale: three models of 2–4B parameters whose language models come from one family (Qwen2.5), and one multiple-choice benchmark of 765 questions.
Corrections are applied in the vision encoder and projector only. The corruptions are synthetic, at a single severity, and one per stream, rather than the mixed degradations met in deployment.

blocks.en:
MAA trains layer-wise adapters in a frozen vision encoder that steer corrupted features back onto the clean manifold, using paired clean–corrupted features and a token-level adversarial constraint [ 13 ] .
A test-time counterpart would have to learn such a token-level correction from the unlabeled stream alone, for instance through consistency across augmentations [ 10 ] .
Whether this is possible without paired data is the question we leave open.

blocks.en: Our use of pre-computed source statistics ( μ src , σ src \mu_{\mathrm{src}},\sigma_{\mathrm{src}} ) sits at the boundary between test-time adaptation and unsupervised domain adaptation and deserves comment. In the standard TTA setting, the model pre-trained on the source domain is available at test time but the source data are not [ 14 ] . Storing summary statistics of the source activations is a one-time offline computation: it requires a single forward pass over a calibration set and a few tensors per layer, on the order of tens of megabytes for a ViT-scale encoder, and grants no access to individual source samples at adaptation time. The same convention is followed by prior feature-alignment methods: ActMAD [ 18 ] aligns test activations with source activation statistics, FOA [ 21 ] measures the discrepancy between test and source statistics and shifts activations to reduce it, and PEA [ 43 ] pre-computes per-block source statistics offline. We adopt it throughout. Retaining these statistics is a mild relaxation of settings that prohibit retaining any information derived from the source domain; the adaptation procedure nevertheless never sees a source example and incurs only a small, fixed storage cost.

blocks.en: Appendix D Activation Patching: Where the Degradation Can Be Repaired
blocks.zh: 附录D 补丁 : 何处可以修复退化

blocks.en:
Activation patching [ 8 ] overwrites activations during a forward pass
with activations cached from a pass on a different input and observes how the output changes. Here
the pass is on a corrupted image, the cached activations come from the same image before
corruption, and we overwrite the output of one encoder sub-module, the attention or MLP branch of
one block, at a time. We measure the share of the lost answer margin, the logit of the correct
option minus the mean logit of the incorrect ones, that returns. Because the clean activation is the
best possible correction for that sub-module, this share upper-bounds what any adaptation confined
to it can achieve, whatever method estimates the correction.

blocks.en:
Li et al. [13] argue that aligning corrupted features with clean references in Euclidean space is not semantics-preserving: the features move geometrically closer to the clean ones while drifting off the in-distribution support on which the language model’s reasoning is calibrated, and this motivates the adversarial manifold constraint of their Manifold-Adversarial Adapters (MAA).
The interpolation above is such a Euclidean operation.
Every intermediate point is a convex combination of the corrupted activation and the clean activation of the same token, and nothing constrains it to lie on either the clean or the corrupted manifold.
If the segment left the support the language model handles, accuracy should dip or stall at intermediate α \alpha . Figure 11 shows no such dip.
Accuracy grows roughly in proportion to α \alpha at every site, no intermediate α \alpha falls below the no-TTA baseline, and the curves meet the clean accuracy at α = 1 \alpha=1 .
This suggests that the straight path from a corrupted token to its own clean counterpart stays within the region the language model reads correctly, at least for this model and corruption.
We do not see this as contradicting MAA.
The drift they describe arises when a feature is pulled toward a clean reference that is not its paired counterpart, as in distribution-level alignment, where the target is a mean or a nearby clean feature rather than the sample’s own clean activation.
Read this way, the obstacle is the sample-blind target rather than the Euclidean geometry of the correction, which is consistent with Section 4.1 .
Two caveats apply.
We do not measure manifold membership directly but infer it from the accuracy along the path, and the sweep covers one model and one corruption.

blocks.en: H.1 Selecting the substituted subset by importance
blocks.zh: H.1 按重要性选择替代子集

blocks.en:
To test whether the recovery curves of Section 4.2 reflect the structure of the
representation or only the statistics of random sampling, we repeated the sweep with the
substituted subset chosen by importance rather than at random. We rank patches and channels
either by the magnitude of their clean activations or by how much these activations vary across the
dataset, two criteria that use no knowledge of where the corruption acts, and substitute either the
highest- or the lowest-ranked units first. No rule changes the shape of the curve
( Figure 13 ): each retains the profile of random selection, including the
flat region at small subset sizes, and differs from it by a roughly constant horizontal factor. Only
the highest-ranked channel rules improve on random selection; the lowest-ranked rules match it, and
on the patch axis informed selection is never better than random and often slightly worse. Choosing
which units to restore therefore rescales the recovery curve at best: the corruption is spread
broadly enough that no cheaply identifiable subset carries the recovery.

blocks.en: A natural objection to correcting activations is that the same robustness might be obtained by simply telling the model that its input is corrupted. We test this directly. The evaluation follows Section 3 with a single change, the system prompt: against a baseline that leaves each model’s default system message unchanged, we evaluate a variant that appends The image may be degraded by visual artifacts that carry no information about the scene. Do not describe or reason about the artifacts. Recover the underlying content from large-scale evidence - object shape, size, position, and context - rather than fine local texture, and answer as if you had been given a clean, sharp version of the same image.

blocks.en: Entropy- and confidence-based TTA rests on the assumption that a model is confident when it is right and uncertain when it is wrong; if so, making predictions more confident also makes them more correct. We test the assumption rather than the method: instead of running an entropy-minimization procedure, we measure, for Qwen2.5-VL-3B on RealWorldQA, how well the model’s confidence in its answer predicts whether the answer is correct, as the area under the ROC curve (AUROC), where 0.5 0.5 means that confidence carries no information about correctness. On clean images the signal is modest (AUROC 0.684 0.684 , 95 % 95\% CI [ 0.645 , 0.720 ] [0.645,0.720] ); under Gaussian noise it falls to 0.588 0.588 [ 0.549 , 0.628 ] [0.549,0.628] , barely above the chance band of [ 0.460 , 0.541 ] [0.460,0.541] expected at this sample size. The assumption fails where it matters most: on all 168 168 questions that corruption turns from correct to incorrect, the model’s top-ranked answer is a distractor, held with an average margin of 0.258 0.258 over the correct option, so a confidence-increasing objective can only entrench the predictions that would need to be overturned.
blocks.zh: 基于Entropy和信心的TTA基于这样的假设:一个模型在正确时是自信的,在错误时是不确定的;如果是的话,使预测更加自信也使得它们更加正确. 我们测试的是假设而不是方法:我们不是运行一个py-最小化程序,而是对RealWorldQA上的Qun2.5-VL-3B进行测量,模型对答案的信心如何能预测答案是否正确,就像ROC曲线(AUROC)下的区域,其中0.5表示信心没有包含正确性的信息. 在干净的图像上,信号是适度的(AUROC 0.684 0.684, 95% 95% CI [0.645, 0.720] [0.645, 0.720];在高斯语噪声下,信号下降到0.588 0.588 [0.549, 0.628] [0.549, 0.628], 略高于这个样本规模预期的[0.460, 0.541] [0.460, 0.541]的机会带. 这一假设在最重要的方面是失败的:在所有168个腐败从正确变为不正确的问题上,模型的顶级答案是分散注意力,平均持有0.258 0.258的正确选择,因此一个增强信心的目标只能巩固那些需要推翻的预测。

blocks.en: This mismatch is structural rather than incidental. Entropy-based TTA was developed for closed-set classification, where each logit corresponds to a fixed semantic class: the “dog” direction means the same thing for every input, so a stream of test samples provides repeated evidence about the same decision boundaries, and methods can accumulate class prototypes, adapt normalization statistics, or tune prompts that encode class semantics. In multiple-choice VQA no such correspondence exists. The output symbols are option letters whose meaning is defined by the question and by the ordering of the choices, so the token A denotes an unrelated proposition on each item, and the option set itself varies in size across the benchmark. Nothing is shared across samples for adaptation to accumulate: there are no persistent class directions to sharpen toward, and confidence in A on one question is not evidence about A on the next. Prompt-tuning methods are the partial exception, since the tuned prompt is a genuinely shared parameter and is not tied to any particular option letter; what it cannot do is carry class semantics, as it does when a prompt is optimized alongside a fixed label set. Any gain must therefore come from generic effects such as an improved instruction or output format, and it is still driven by a confidence signal that our measurements show is only weakly related to correctness. What remains is per-sample sharpening of a distribution over symbols, which cannot change the answer, and parameter updates guided by that same weak signal.
blocks.zh: 这种不匹配是结构性的,而不是偶然的. 以Entropy为基础的TTA是为闭塞集分类而开发的,其中每个日志对应一个固定的语义类:"狗"方向对每个输入都意味着相同的东西,因此一流的测试样本为相同的决定界限提供了重复的证据,方法可以积累类原型,适应常态统计,或者调音提示来编码类语义. 在多选择的 VQA 中,不存在此类函证. 输出符号是选项字母,其含义由问题和选择的顺序来定义,因此符号A表示每个项目上一个无关的命题,而选项本身设定的大小在整个基准上有所不同. 无法在样本之间共享任何适应性来积累:没有持续的阶级方向可以朝向,对一个问题A的信心并不是对下一个问题A的证据. 即时调音法是部分例外,因为被调音的即时是真正共享的参数,不与任何特定选项字母相绑;它不能做的是携带类语义,就像它与固定标签集一起优化一个即时. 因此,任何收益都必须来自通用效果,如改进了的指令或输出格式,它仍然受到一个信心信号的驱动,即我们的测量显示与正确性只有微弱的关系. 剩下的是逐个样地将一个分布在符号上而不能改变答案,以及以同样的弱信号为指导的参数更新.
